name: Brain and Cognitive Sciences Lab
description: This course will provide students with practicum skills that are critical for research in cognitive sciences, the course will train students for Part 1: understanding of neurons and neuronal processes, Part II: recording of eye movement, brain activity during cognitive processes (visual perception, language, cognitive tasks), behavioral studies under controlled conditions, Part III: Brain and neuroimaging focused on MRI and brain signal processing, gait analysis. The lab course will equip a student with an understanding of data collection, analysis, and interpretation of physiological, neuroscientific, behavioral methodologies that contribute to research in brain and cognitive science.
